mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen in every one of the last four weekly means (-39.6, -27.6, -22.6, -21.3), an autoregressive reopening momentum signal; that same momentum carries RETAIL_REC to a higher 28-day mean over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose 18.3 points from t-3w (-39.6) to t-0w (-21.3)
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to -27.8 percent, the mean of the last four weekly prints.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has recovered 11.9 points from its t-3w trough to -54.1 percent; once the weekly TRANSIT mean crosses above -55 percent, transit-borne foot traffic into retail corridors lifts RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises above -55 percent from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -66.0 at t-3w to -54.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: In weeks where TRANSIT prints above -55.0, the following 14-day RETAIL_REC mean fails to exceed the preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has fallen from +16.0 to +8.4 percent above baseline, showing households leaving home more often; when the RESIDENTIAL weekly mean drops below +10 percent, discretionary out-of-home retail visits rise over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below +10 percent above baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from 16.0 at t-3w to 8.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: Weeks with RESIDENTIAL below +10 percent are followed by a next-14-day RETAIL_REC mean that is not higher than the prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES remains 23 points below baseline but improved from -35.3 to -23.0 across the window; continued office re-occupancy restores weekday commuter and lunch-hour traffic that lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 12.3 points from t-3w (-35.3) to t-0w (-23.0)
failure_condition: The next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean declines or is flat while WORKPLACES weekly means continue rising toward baseline.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS rebounds toward baseline (to -6.4 at t-1w and -14.0 at t-0w) mark outdoor recreation substitution; when the PARKS weekly mean exceeds -10 percent, discretionary spend shifts to open-air activity and RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean rises above -10 percent from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS oscillated between -14.6 and -6.4 while RETAIL_REC recovered
failure_condition: Weeks where PARKS exceeds -10 percent are followed by a RETAIL_REC weekly mean at or above the preceding week's value in more than half of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Retail footfall depends on joint transit and workplace recovery: TRANSIT above -55 combined in the same week with WORKPLACES above -25 produces compounding commuter-driven traffic that pushes RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks, while either signal alone is insufficient.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT above -55 and WORKPLACES above -25 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT -54.1 and WORKPLACES -23.0 jointly satisfy both thresholds at t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT is above -55 and WORKPLACES above -25 in the same week, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not above the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: With TRANSIT still 54.1 points below baseline, a renewed containment regime reinstating capacity limits is signalled when TRANSIT falls back below -60; that policy response cuts retail-and-recreation footfall over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean falls back below -60 percent from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT remains 54.1 points below baseline at t-0w after a -66.0 trough
failure_condition: After TRANSIT prints below -60, the next-14-day RETAIL_REC mean is equal to or above the prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS moving toward baseline while GROCERY_PHARM converges to -1.3 indicates a seasonal mobility release toward open-air activity; the spring outdoor pull diverts trips away from indoor retail-and-recreation venues, lowering RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -6.7 to -1.3 across the window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean exceeds the last-28-day mean while PARKS continues improving and GROCERY_PHARM stays within 2 points of baseline.
